title: Inverse Energy Cascade and Non-uniqueness for the Advection-Diffusion Equation
summary: We prove non-uniqueness for the advection-diffusion equation with a drift in a logarithmically near-critical class below $L_t^2L_x^\infty$. The first construction is a diffusion-assisted inverse cascade of scalar energy that diverges as $t \to 0$. The second uses compressed inverse mixing, with diffusion acting perturbatively, and produces a bounded parabolic solution with the energy jump at the initial time.
